d:
"Stolen Moments" was the first single ahead of Anoushka Shankar's new mini-album, "Chapter I: Forever, For Now". Released by LEITER, the four-track collection is available now on limited edition vinyl and via all digital platforms.
Written by Anoushka Shankar and Arooj Aftab
Produced by Arooj Aftab
Anoushka Shankar: Sitar
Nils Frahm: Harmonium, Glass Harmonica
Magda Giannikou: Accordion
